operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. BPPBB1, BYPBB1, BYPBB2, and BYPBB1MW)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 25 hours per year for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT).

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. BPPBB1, BYPBB1, BYPBB2, and BYPBB1MW)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 500 hours per year for all purposes (as provided in Condition 8) combined. The annual limits for hours of operation shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: All engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. BPEG1 through BPEG22, BPPBB1, BYEG1 through BYEG120, BYPBB1, BYPBB2, and BYPBB1MW)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: The approved fuel is ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil, meeting ASTM D975 for grade ultra-low sulfur 2-D or 2-D S15, or having a maximum sulfur content not to exceed 0.0015% by weight (15 ppm), and either a minimum cetane number of 40 or maximum aromatic content of 35 volume percent.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: 750 ekW emergency engine gen-set (Ref. No. BPPBB1)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall consume no more than 737 gallons of diesel fuel oil per year, calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period (all uses).

operationalLimits.appliesTo: 750 ekW emergency engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. BYPBB1 and BYPBB2)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall consume no more than 1,474 gallons of diesel fuel oil per year, combined, calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period (all uses).

operationalLimits.appliesTo: 1,000 ekW emergency engine gen-set (Ref. No. BYPBB1MW)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall consume no more than 965 gallons of diesel fuel oil per year, calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period (all uses).

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Non-emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. BPEG1 through BPEG22 and BYEG1 through BYEG120)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall only consume a combined quantity of diesel fuel oil not exceeding 20,398,443 gallons each consecutive 365-day period (all uses), as demonstrated by using the equation provided in Condition 16.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: All engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. BPEG1 through BPEG22, BPPBB1, BYEG1 through BYEG120, BYPBB1, BYPBB2, and BYPBB1MW)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No engine gen-set shall be operated for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), stack testing, or operational training (that involves fuel combustion) between the hours of 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: All engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. BPEG1 through BPEG22, BPPBB1, BYEG1 through BYEG120, BYPBB1, BYPBB2, and BYPBB1MW)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: During the integration operational period, any operation of the unit (that involves fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30 shall only occur if the forecast Air Quality Index (AQI) for ozone for that day is less than or equal to 100. If an Air Alert is issued for Metropolitan Washington, D.C. for a day with forecasted AQI <= 100, operation shall be minimized.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Cummins C3250D6E/QSK95-G12 engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. BYEG1 through BYEG120)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: If installed with a maximum capacity of 3,250 ekW, shall be equipped with a controller to limit each unit's electrical power output to no more than 3,000 ekW.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Non-emergency engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. BPEG1 through BPEG22)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: The catalyst bed exhaust temperature shall not exceed 1,022°F.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Cummins Model C3000D6E/QSK95-G12 and de-rated Cummins Model C3320D6E/QSK95-G12 engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. BYEG1 through BYEG120)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: The catalyst bed exhaust temperature shall not exceed 920°F.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Caterpillar Model 3516E engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. BYEG1 through BYEG120)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: The catalyst bed exhaust temperature shall not exceed 1,022°F.
